resolved.short_description: VPN won't connect from home, error 809
resolved.description: Since last night the VPN returns error 809. Internet works fine.
resolved.close_notes: UDP ports blocked by the home router. Configured SSL gateway vpn-ssl.corp.local, connection OK.

resolved.description: After the password change Outlook asks for credentials every 5 minutes.

resolved.close_notes: Old password saved in the iPhone Mail app. Updated, no further lockouts.

resolved.short_description: 2nd floor printer not printing, queue stuck
resolved.description: Documents stay in the queue with an error status.
resolved.close_notes: Cleared the spool folder and restarted the spooler on the PC. Printing OK.

resolved.description: SAP GUI shows 'partner not reached' on the PRD system.
resolved.close_notes: VPN was not connected. SAP works after connecting the VPN.

resolved.short_description: Laptop disk full, cannot save files

resolved.short_description: Teams: others can't hear me in meetings

resolved.close_notes: Windows privacy settings were blocking the microphone. Enabled access, fixed.

resolved.description: At startup the PC asks for the BitLocker key.

resolved.description: OneDrive shows a sync error on several files.
